notes.title: Fortune: Undo
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]
This marks the seventh game update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]. The update allows repositioning forts after they have just been placed in between levels.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[b]Primary[/b]
- Added repositioning

Sprout mode
- Dilemmas now appear every 5 levels (were every 2 levels)
- Flying enemies now have 1/3rd of regular health (was 1/4th)
- Boss enemies now have 1.5x of regular health (was 2x)
- Changed the health ramp to [code]floor( pow(LEVEL, 1.65) ) + LEVEL + max(0, max(0, LEVEL-30)*3-8 ) [/code]

[b]Fort: Dread[/b]

- New icon


[b]Fort: Void[/b]

- Branch B: Break for -2g (was Dread for 15g)

[h3]Discord[/h3] Join the [url=https://discord.gg/dVyQtKv]game Discord[/url] to discuss the game, provide feedback and get your suggestions ignored. 

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

Regards,
Rokas

notes.title: Fortune: Sprout
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]
This marks the sixth game update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]. The update brings back the Sprout mode with Dilemmas as the default mode.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[b]Primary[/b]
- Defeat screen now leads to [Retry] instead of [Menu] 
- Added Sprout mode, focusing on level type variety
- Paused menu now lets you [Resume] by clicking on the info bar
- Attempted to patch crashing on Death map
- Hidden 65+ achievements
- Added achievement for reaching [Victory] in Sprout mode
- Added new fort: Void
- Added new fort: Heart

[b]Sprout mode[/b]
- There are 60 levels
- Every 4th level is a mass level, which doubles the number of level enemies
- Every 5th level is flying, which ignores your mazing
- Every 6th level is a boss level, which has a single enemy

[b]Fort: Heart[/b]
- Speed: 1
- Damage: floor(lives/10)
- Branch A: Lives +10 for 10g
- Branch B: Lives -1 for -1g

[b]Fort: Void[/b]
- Speed: 0
- Damage: 0
- Branch A: Void for 5g 
- Branch B: Dread for 15g

[h3]Discord[/h3] Join the [url=https://discord.gg/dVyQtKv]game Discord[/url] to discuss the game, provide feedback and get your suggestions ignored. 

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

Regards,
Rokas

notes.title: Fortune: Magma
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]
This marks the fourth game update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]. The update brings back dilemma permanence, separates endless mode from the default one, introduces [b]Magma[/b].

[h3]Leaderboard[/h3]
Top 15 scores of the previous update:[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36969244/990a6090a20854c439d2ca0d088c66cf9466ca3d.png[/img]
The scores above highlighted the issue of an endless mode with scaling health and flying enemies every 5 levels, with Level 20 being a brick wall for progress. You can view the whole board [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1031790/leaderboards/4340360]here[/url].

[h3]Forts[/h3]
    [b]Magma[/b] (new)
        Magma +
            Magma            at 20g
            Damage +1         at 15g
        Speed: 1
        Damage: 2
        ---------
        Magma can be seen as a slower branching, more powerful Dread.

    [b]Doom[/b]
        Doom+
            Damage    +1 at 10g        (was Damage +1 at 20g)
            Damage    +2 at 15g        (was Damage +1 at 30g)
        Speed:      1	(was 2)
        Damage:   1
        ---------
        Doom now starts as powerful as Dread.

[h3]Dilemmas[/h3]
Dilemmas in this update:
[table]
 [tr][th]Level[/th] [th]Option 1[/th]  [th]Option 2[/th]
 [/tr][tr][td]1[/td] [td]Dread[/td]  [td]Magma[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]2[/td] [td]Health +1[/td]  [td]Speed +1[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]3[/td] [td]Health x2[/td]  [td]Gold -10[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]4[/td] [td]Health x2[/td]  [td]Speed +1[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]5[/td] [td]Health +4[/td]  [td]Toggle Flight[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]6[/td] [td]Panic[/td]  [td]Doom[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]7[/td] [td]Health +5[/td]  [td]Gold -30[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]8[/td] [td]Lives +35[/td]  [td]Pace 2[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]9[/td] [td]Health +2[/td]  [td]Armor +1[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]10[/td] [td]Speed +1[/td]  [td]Toggle Flight[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]11[/td] [td]Doubt[/td]  [td]Mill +1[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]12[/td] [td]Health +8[/td]  [td]Speed +4[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]13[/td] [td]Bounty +1[/td]  [td]Enemies -5[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]14[/td] [td]Health x2[/td]  [td]Speed +2[/td]
 [/tr][tr][td]15[/td] [td]Enemies +10[/td]  [td]Toggle Flight[/td]
[/tr] [/table]
[h3]Floors[/h3]
Eternower now has two floors:[list][*]First Floor:[list][*] 15 levels
[*] Dilemmas each level
[*] Enemy features are only changed through dilemmas
[*] Completion of the 15th one yields Victory[/list] 
First floor focuses on your ability to adapt to the rapidly increasing difficulty through dilemmas.

[*]Second Floor:[list][*] Endless levels
[*] [b]Dread[/b] or [b]Magma[/b] dilemma every 10 levels
[*] Enemy health scales exponentially with each level
[*] Getting defeated uploads your progress score to the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1031790/leaderboards/4405024]leaderboard[/url].
[/list]
Second floor focuses on your ability to create a maze.[/list]
[h3]Armor[/h3]
A new dilemma now allows increasing the armor of enemies. Armor reduces incoming enemy damage. For example, to kill an enemy with 1 health and 1 armor in one shot, you need to do 2 damage once or 1.2 damage 5 times.

[h3]Other[/h3]
Most dilemmas now show the direct value change from the previous one.
    
[h3]Discord:[/h3]    Join the [url=https://discord.gg/dVyQtKv]game Discord[/url] to discuss the game, provide feedback and get your suggestions ignored. 
    Also help with translations at some later point.

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

Regards,
Rokas

notes.title: Fortune: Board
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]    This marks the third game update for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url], which introduces the [b]Leaderboard[/b].

[h3]Leaderboard[/h3]    Upon eventually reaching Defeat, your score is uploaded to the Steam Leaderboard.
    The top 3 entries are visible upon hovering on the info-panel.
    Press on the entries to see how they constructed their mazes.

[h3]Levels[/h3]    Levels are now never ending (Dilemmas end at Level 15)
    Consider completing Level 15 as beating the game and levels from then on as a test of endurance.

[h3]Dilemmas[/h3]      Level 3:    Pace → 3 (was 2)    /     Flight   
    Level 14:    Health +20             /     Pace → 2 (was 1)
    
[h3]Discord:[/h3]    Join the [url=https://discord.gg/dVyQtKv]game Discord[/url] to discuss the game, provide feedback and get your suggestions ignored. 
    Also help with translations at some later point.

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

notes.title: Fortune: Balance
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]
This marks the second game update, which rebalances forts and level fortunes, adds [b]Panic[/b].

[h3]Forts[/h3]
    [b]Dread[/b]
        Dread+
            Dread     at 10g        (was Dead at 5g)
            Break     at  -5g        (was Doubt at 10g)
        Speed:      1	(was 0)
        Damage:   1	(was 0)
        ---------
        Dread once again deals damage.

    [b]Doom[/b]
        Doom+
            Damage    +1 at 20g        (was Doom at 25g)
            Damage    +2 at 30g        (was Damage +1 at [10 + dmg x 5]g)
        Speed:      2	(was 5)
        Damage:   1
        ---------
        Doom can now only be upgraded.
    
    [b]Doubt[/b]
        Doubt+
            Dread                    at   25g     (was Convert: Dread at -5g)
            Convert: Dread      at -10g     (was Break at 10g)
        Speed:      2	(was 1)
        Damage:   2    (was 5)
        ---------
        Doubt can now only attack flying enemies.

    [b]Panic[/b] (new)
        Panic+
            Convert: Dread    at -1g
            Damage +1           at -1g
        Speed: 10
        Damage: 10
        ---------
        Panic loses 1 damage per attack.

[h3]Levels[/h3]    Level health:  [LEVEL*3 + max(0, LEVEL-5)*5 + max(0, LEVEL-10)*10]        (was [2*LEVEL])
    Level speed:   1    (was 5)
    Starting gold: 0    (was 10)
    ---------
    Levels are considerably more punishing

[h3]Dilemmas:[/h3]    Level 1:    Dread             /     Doom 
    Level 2:    Lives +40       /     Bounty +1
    Level 3:    Pace → 2       /     Flight
    Level 4:    Health +10    /     Speed +1
    Level 5:    Walk              /     Bounty +1
    Level 6:    Doubt            /     Panic 
    Level 7:    Lives +50      /     Mill +1
    Level 8:    Health +15    /     Pace → 2
    Level 9:    Pace → 2      /     Speed +1
    Level 10:   Walk            /     Enemies -5
    Level 11:   Panic            /     Doom
    Level 12:   Enemies +2  /     Enemies -2
    Level 13:   Health +5     /     Gold -10

    Level-modifying dilemmas now only effect the next immediate level.
    
[h3]Discord:[/h3]    Join the [url=https://discord.gg/dVyQtKv]game Discord[/url] to discuss the game, provide feedback and get your suggestions ignored. 
    Also help with translations at some later point.

[h3]Other:[/h3]    Dilemma prompt reappears if it is not picked after revealing it 

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

Regards,
Rokas

notes.title: Release! + Game Plan
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey,[/h3]This post marks the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url], compares the demo and paid game versions and outlines the planned future of the game.

[h3]Release[/h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url] is now officially live!
Play the demo and buy the game if you enjoy it.

[h3]Demo vs Full Game[/h3]The demo, as released today, is mostly the same as the paid game.
The demo, as released today, has 1 tower, while the paid game has 2. 

[h3]Game Plan[/h3]The game is released at $1 (or equivalent).
The plan is to improve the game via updates and increase the price gradually over time.
The updates would be focused on the paid game, leaving the demo as is or with minor changes.
Buying the game early will grant access to all potential price-raising updates.

[h3]Warning[/h3]Note, the plan does not exclude the possibility of paid DLC.
It's also possible that the game will get absolutely zero updates. Beware!

Thanks for reading, go play [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1031790/Eternower/]Eternower[/url]!

Regards,
Rokas
